data.case_title: Accident recognition (Arbeitsunfall) for son Paul – Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte
data.title: Recognition of your son's school accident as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall)
data.summary: The Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte (statutory accident insurance) informs Johanna Beispielacker that her son Paul's bicycle fall on his way to school on 14 September 2026 is recognised as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall), and that the insurer will pay his medical and physiotherapy costs directly. It also notes an objection right and, separately, an upcoming unchanged automatic debit of €— (amount not stated) on 28 December 2026 under a different contract (SM-9060-438).
data.explanation: This is good news: the accident insurer accepts your son's fall on his school commute as a covered work accident and will pay his doctor and physiotherapy bills directly with the practices, so you should not submit any receipts yourself. If you disagree with any part of this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app will show the deadline computed from the rules that apply. Otherwise, no action is needed from you for this claim. The letter also mentions an automatic debit for an unrelated contract (SM-9060-438) on 28 December 2026 — this looks out of place in an accident-recognition letter, so it is worth double-checking with the sender that this detail is genuine and correctly addressed to you.

remedy.period_text: innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde
remedy.form_text: Richten Sie ihn schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift an: Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte, Präventionsweg 9, 34117 Musterkassel.
remedy.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.

key_facts.label: Accident recognised (Anerkennung als Arbeitsunfall)
key_facts.quote: den Unfall Ihres Sohnes Paul am 14.09.2026 erkennen wir als Arbeitsunfall an.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for coverage of school commute
key_facts.quote: Schulwege sind nach § 8 Abs. 2 SGB VII versichert.

key_facts.label: Deemed delivery of letters sent by post (Bekanntgabe)
key_facts.quote: Schicken wir Ihnen den Bescheid mit der Post, ist er am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden bekannt gegeben (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X).

key_facts.label: Next automatic debit for separate contract (Vertrag SM-9060-438)
key_facts.quote: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 28.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with any part of the decision, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Unfallkasse by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde

items.title: Do not submit the medical bills yourself
items.action: Let the treating doctors and the physiotherapy practice send their invoices directly to the Unfallkasse; do not forward any receipts yourself.
items.quote: Rechnungen schicken die Praxen direkt an uns; bitte reichen Sie selbst keine Belege ein.

items.title: Automatic debit for a separate contract (SM-9060-438)
items.action: Check that an automatic debit of unchanged amount for this separate contract (SM-9060-438) is expected and correctly addressed to you, since it is unusual for this type of letter.
items.quote: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 28.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.

warnings: This accident-recognition letter unexpectedly includes a paragraph about a separate contract (SM-9060-438) and an automatic direct debit of unchanged, unstated amount on 28 December 2026 — unrelated to the accident claim and unusual for this type of official letter; verify this detail directly with the sender before relying on it.

The stated deemed-delivery rule of the fourth day after posting differs from the commonly cited third-day rule under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X; double-check the exact wording with the sender if the objection deadline matters to you.
